text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell here. Each fix was checked by reading it against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`fees.py`**: the fee added `DAILY_FEE` to the days late instead of multiplying by it (`days_late * DAILY_FEE`).
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3; it's now 5, matching the tests and the code comment.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many; it now returns the last `n` (`[-n:]`). I also made it return an empty list when `n <= 0`, which the tests don't check.
- **`factory.py`**: the sample books were missing the third title, so I added `Emma`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string; it's now converted to an integer.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`); it now imports from `catalog.text`.

I didn't change any tests.
